combo_label: At the Seaside × Board Game Night × Norse Mythology

entries.clue: Striped canvas seat that folds flat, and nips your fingers if you rush it
Shining god slain by a mistletoe dart guided by a trickster's hand
Player trusted with the money tray who somehow ends up richest
Slithery slides that undo your progress in a children's dice-and-ladders game
One of three sisters at the well of fate, carving what must come for gods and men
Sandcastle mould with a handle, also handy for hauling seawater up the beach.
Victorian walkway on iron legs, striding out over the water to a pavilion
Diamond of fabric on a long string, flown where the breeze never drops
Card pile that may fine you for speeding or march you back three spaces
Thor's wife, shorn by a prank and given new hair spun from gold by dwarfs
Giant wolf bound by a ribbon made of impossible things, waiting to swallow a god
